children.title: Walking-distance lodging at or near Marcon
children.summary: Six lodging options within ~1 km of Restaurant Régis & Jacques Marcon, ranked by walk time and trade-offs.

children.title: Special-character lodging within taxi range of Marcon
children.summary: Distinctive sleeps within a 30-min taxi of Marcon — troglodyte rooms, yurts, heritage manor.

children.title: Day-trips and activities within 30 km of Marcon
children.summary: Half-day and full-day options around Saint-Bonnet-le-Froid — hikes, memorial, steam train, safari park, markets.

children.title: IT conferences and tech events within 30 km of Marcon
children.summary: Zero scheduled IT events inside 30 km in 2026; closest dev conferences sit 50–140 km away.

sources.title: Hôtel Marcon — Boutique réservation
sources.claim: Hôtel Marcon double from €430 HT; reservations open on a 6-month rolling window from the 1st of each month at 10h00.

sources.title: Les Yourtes de Larssialas
sources.claim: Three contemporary yurts at ~1,200 m in the Larsiallas hamlet, €60–110/night, private bathroom and terrace each.

sources.title: Manoir du Grail — Wikipedia
sources.claim: Heritage-listed manor in Devesset with defensive elements and mullioned windows, inscribed on the Inventaire général since 2006.

sources.title: Rome2Rio — taxi Saint-Bonnet to Annonay
sources.claim: Saint-Bonnet-le-Froid to Annonay is 26.7 km, ~25 min by taxi, €60–75.

sources.title: Lac de Devesset — Ardèche Hautes Vallées
sources.claim: Lac de Devesset has an easy 3.5 km loop trail; supervised swimming only July–August.

sources.title: Yad Vashem — Collective Rescue
sources.claim: Le Chambon-sur-Lignon and surrounding communes collectively honored as Righteous Among the Nations, plaque unveiled 1990.

sources.title: Climate-Data — Saint-Bonnet-le-Froid
sources.claim: Saint-Bonnet-le-Froid has a Cfb climate; May is the wettest month (~13.7 rainy days).

sources.title: Lieu de Mémoire — horaires & tarifs
sources.claim: Open daily except Monday, 10h–12h30 and 14h–18h in high season; full price €5 (€7 during temporary exhibitions).

sources.title: Velay Express — informations pratiques
sources.claim: Runs Sundays and May public holidays May–October; route stops at Raucoules, Tence, Le Chambon-sur-Lignon and Saint-Agrève.

sources.title: Routes vers l'IA Ardèche 2026
sources.claim: Held 28 April 2026 at RCCM Saint-Clair — past at time of planning.

sources.title: DevFest Lyon 2026
sources.claim: Held 4 December 2026 at Palais de la Bourse, Lyon (~140 km).

sources.title: Hôtel Régis & Jacques Marcon
sources.claim: 4-star Relais & Châteaux with 10 troglodyte rooms (9×50m², 1×95m²), salt-treated pool reserved for guests, European eco-label.

sources.title: Restaurant Régis et Jacques Marcon
sources.claim: 3 Michelin stars at 18 Chemin de Brard, Larsiallas, Saint-Bonnet-le-Froid.

sources.title: Les Maisons Marcon
sources.claim: Family ecosystem: gastronomic restaurant, bistrot, Bar de Païs, La Chanterelle bakery, Relais & Châteaux hotel, spa, cooking school, shop.

sources.title: Les Maisons Marcon — Relais & Châteaux
sources.claim: Relais & Châteaux member operating multiple lodging properties in Saint-Bonnet-le-Froid.

sources.title: Hôtel Le Clos des Cimes
sources.claim: 3-star in a historic stone house, 30m² valley-view rooms and 38m² junior suites; spa access included.

sources.title: Hôtel La Découverte
sources.claim: 3-star with 18m² double/twin rooms, renovated 2015 — the Marcon value option.

sources.title: Bistrot La Coulemelle
sources.claim: Bib Gourmand bistrot, Rue du Vivarais, open Thursday to Monday, 50 seats.

sources.title: Chambres Chatelard
sources.claim: Four village-centre suites at 16bis rue du Vivarais with hammam included; €130–165 per night.

sources.title: Auberge des Myrtilles
sources.claim: Restored country farmhouse, 5 rooms with private terrace; Logis Étik label.

sources.title: Les Bruyères de Gaschon
sources.claim: Insolite stays — Finnish barrel, gypsy caravan, Auvergne cabin — open early April to mid-November.

sources.title: Hob Fort du Pré
sources.claim: 29 rooms with on-site restaurant, spa, heated indoor pool, sauna, fitness centre.

sources.title: Hôtel Clair Matin
sources.claim: 17th-century farm in Le Chambon-sur-Lignon, run by the 4th generation of the Bard family; 25 rooms, spa, outdoor pool.

sources.title: Mont Mézenc
sources.claim: Highest peak in the Ardèche at 1753 m; 360° panorama from the Alps to Puy de Dôme; standard ascent ~2h round trip from Croix des Boutières.

sources.title: Visorando — Mont Mézenc loop
sources.claim: Loop from Croix de Peccata is 6.4 km, ~260 m elevation, around 2h35, moderate difficulty.

sources.title: Mont Gerbier-de-Jonc
sources.claim: Summit hike is a steep 1.2 km path, ~1h30 round trip; Sentier des Sources de la Loire is an easy 3 km circuit.

sources.title: Mont Chiniac
sources.claim: 1116 m family belvédère above Saint-Agrève; 6 km Chante-coucou loop through the Forêt de la Rèche.

sources.title: Lalouvesc — randonnées
sources.claim: Lalouvesc at 1100 m, junction of GR420 and GR430; 22+ marked walks including the 6 km Tour du Mont Chaix.

sources.title: Musée Saint-Régis
sources.claim: Lalouvesc — open daily 30 March to 9 November 2026, free admission; diorama of 19 painted scenes by Georges Serraz.

sources.title: Safari de Peaugres
sources.claim: 5 km drive-through safari + 3h walking section; 80 ha, 1,200 animals; adult €29.90.

sources.title: Safari de Peaugres — horaires
sources.claim: April–September daily 10:00–18:30 (9:30–19:00 July–August).

sources.title: Musée des Papeteries Canson & Montgolfier
sources.claim: 700 rue de Vidalon, Davézieux. Wed & Sun 14h30–18h year-round; adult €6.50.

sources.title: Canson & Montgolfier — Ardèche Grand Air
sources.claim: Set in the Montgolfier brothers' birthplace; guided demonstrations of 17th–21st-century paper-making.

sources.title: NaturaLoisirs Saint-Bonnet-le-Froid
sources.claim: Bike rental (Giant partner) at 9 rue du Velay. Open Thu–Sun in spring, Wed–Sun July–September.

sources.title: Cave Marcon
sources.claim: 46 rue du Velay; fine wines, local products; group tastings by appointment.

sources.title: Saint-Bonnet-le-Froid (mairie)
sources.claim: Haute-Loire village of about 280 inhabitants at 1,200 m altitude.

sources.title: Le Chambon-sur-Lignon — OT Haut-Lignon
sources.claim: 874–1139 m on the Vivarais-Lignon plateau; only French village awarded the Righteous title collectively.

sources.title: Velay Express — tarifs
sources.claim: 2026 tickets: adult €16.50–€22.50, child (4–12) €13.50–€19.50; steam (vapeur) and diesel (autorail) on the heritage Galoche line.

sources.title: Les Marraignes (donkey hikes)
sources.claim: Donkey-accompanied walks, farm visits in Saint-Agrève; school-holiday sessions Tue–Thu 10h00–11h30 and Fri 16h30–18h00.

sources.title: ENSP Yssingeaux
sources.claim: École Nationale Supérieure de la Pâtisserie at Château de Montbarnier, founded 1984 by Yves Thuriès and Alain Ducasse.

sources.title: Yssingeaux — Hôtel de Ville
sources.claim: 15th-century fortified former summer residence of Jean de Bourbon, bishop of Le Puy.

sources.title: Mont Mézenc — AllTrails
sources.claim: Mont Mézenc road not cleared in winter; best visited February–November; late-spring snow can affect summit road into May.

sources.title: Lieu de Mémoire — Shoah 1944-1948
sources.claim: Reopened 4 March 2026 with temporary exhibition 'La fin de la Shoah', running through 31 May 2026.

sources.title: USHMM — Le Chambon-sur-Lignon
sources.claim: Le Chambon and surrounding villages (pop. ~24,000) sheltered an estimated 3,000–3,500 Jews from 1940 to 1944.
